scenarios.reason: The checkpoint could not verify the prior bag total from the confirmation page.

scenarios.name: Free shipping from €50
scenarios.reason:
Added House Espresso and Paper Filters to the bag as requested.
Opened the bag and confirmed shipping was €4.90 with a total of €49.40.
Pressed the plus button next to Paper Filters once; shipping changed to Free and the total updated to €51.00.

scenarios.name: Promo code total
scenarios.reason:
Added Ethiopia Guji to the bag twice and added one Hand Grinder.
Opened the bag, entered the lowercase promo code welcome10, and applied it.
The discount was −€9.10, shipping was Free, and the final total was €81.90.

fix.summary: The free shipping threshold was set to 50 while prices are stored in cents, so it applied at €0.50; it is now 50 * 100 (€50).
